description: This file defines the interface for the ARCv2 Interrupt Unit device driver, including functions to enable, disable, set priority, configure security, and handle interrupt trigger types for specific IRQs.

methods.name: z_arc_v2_irq_unit_irq_enable_set
methods.description: Sets the enable or disable state of a specific IRQ.

methods.name: z_arc_v2_irq_unit_int_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific IRQ is enabled.

methods.name: z_arc_v2_irq_unit_prio_set
methods.description: Sets the priority of a specific IRQ.

methods.name: z_arc_v2_irq_uinit_secure_set
methods.description: Configures the security state of a specific IRQ (conditional on CONFIG_ARC_SECURE_FIRMWARE).

methods.name: z_arc_v2_irq_unit_sensitivity_set
methods.description: Sets the trigger sensitivity (level or pulse) for a specific IRQ.

methods.name: z_arc_v2_irq_unit_is_in_isr
methods.description: Checks if the processor is currently handling an interrupt or exception.

methods.name: z_arc_v2_irq_unit_trigger_set
methods.description: Configures the trigger type (level or pulse) for a specific IRQ.

methods.name: z_arc_v2_irq_unit_trigger_get
methods.description: Retrieves the trigger type for a specific IRQ.

methods.name: z_arc_v2_irq_unit_int_eoi
methods.description: Sends an End Of Interrupt signal for a specific IRQ.
